title: Horizon Potion
description: This plugin adds a new potion to your server!
body:
# ☁️ HorizonPotion

**HorizonPotion** adds the **Heaven Potion** — a custom "Rapture" brew that launches players into the sky, drifts them safely back down on angel wings, blasts nearby enemies with a burst of divine light, and rewards a safe landing with a healing blessing.

Perfect as an escape button, a scouting tool, or a way to reach your sky base.

## ✨ What it does

Drink it, and in order:

1. **Ascend** — you're launched up toward build height.
2. **Drift** — Slow Falling carries you down safely (no fall damage).
3. **Divine light** — nearby hostile mobs are knocked back and blinded.
4. **Blessed landing** — you gain Regeneration and Absorption on touchdown.

## ⚙️ Deeply configurable

Almost *every* value is tunable from a clean `config.yml` — no code required:

- Launch mode (build height / relative / fixed), height, teleport vs. velocity
- Slow-fall duration, fall-damage immunity, optional forward "steering" drift
- Divine light radius, knockback, blindness — toggle mobs and/or players
- Landing rewards (Regeneration & Absorption), amplifiers and durations
- Per-use cooldown, blocked worlds/environments (Nether & End off by default)
- Particles & sounds, potion color, name, lore, glint, custom model data
- Crafting recipe (shapeless **or** shaped) — fully customizable
- All text supports **MiniMessage** (gradients, hex colors, formatting)

Changes apply live with `/heavenpotion reload` (recipe changes need a restart).

## 🧪 How to get it

Craft it — a shapeless recipe:

> **Water Bottle + Feather + Glowstone Dust + Ghast Tear → Heaven Potion**

Or grant it with `/heavenpotion` (aliases: `/rapture`, `/heavenpot`).

## 🔑 Commands & permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/heavenpotion` | Get a Heaven Potion | `horizonpotion.give` |
| `/heavenpotion <player>` | Give one to a player | `horizonpotion.give` |
| `/heavenpotion reload` | Reload the config | `horizonpotion.reload` |

Players drink with `horizonpotion.use` and craft with `horizonpotion.craft` (both on by default).

## 🧩 Compatibility

- **Server:** Paper / Purpur (or any Paper fork)
- **Minecraft:** 1.21.x (single jar works across all 1.21.x)
- **Java:** 21+
